description: This file defines error handling structures and functions for field validation errors in Kubernetes, including error types, error messages, and utility functions for error management.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Represents a field-level validation error with type, field, bad value, and detail.

classes.name: ErrorType
classes.description: Enumerates the types of validation errors, such as required, duplicate, invalid, etc.

classes.name: ErrorList
classes.description: A list of Error objects, with utility methods for aggregation and filtering.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the error, including field and error body.

methods.name: ErrorBody
methods.description: Returns the error message without the field name, for higher-level error reporting.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Converts ErrorType to its canonical string message.

methods.name: NotFound
methods.description: Creates an Error indicating a value was not found.

methods.name: Required
methods.description: Creates an Error indicating a required value is missing.

methods.name: Duplicate
methods.description: Creates an Error indicating a duplicate value.

methods.name: Invalid
methods.description: Creates an Error indicating an invalid value.

methods.name: NotSupported
methods.description: Creates an Error indicating an unsupported value, with supported options.

methods.name: Forbidden
methods.description: Creates an Error indicating a forbidden value.

methods.name: TooLong
methods.description: Creates an Error indicating a value exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: TooMany
methods.description: Creates an Error indicating too many items in a list.

methods.name: InternalError
methods.description: Creates an Error indicating an internal error not related to user input.

methods.name: ErrorList
methods.description: Holds multiple Error objects with methods for conversion and filtering.

methods.name: NewErrorTypeMatcher
methods.description: Returns a matcher function to filter errors by ErrorType.

methods.name: fromAggregate
methods.description: Converts a utilerrors.Aggregate back to ErrorList.
